face.name: 冰霜女王辛达苟萨
face.text: 巨型+2 在一个敌方随从被冻结后，将其消灭。
face.flavorText: 辛达苟萨用她最后的一丝气息，诅咒她的爱侣，以及所有任由她死在冰冠冰川的生灵。当她在巫妖王的手中重生之时，她吐出了新生的第一口寒气。那是饱含痛苦的寒气。

face.name: Frost Queen Sindragosa
face.text: Colossal +2 After an enemy minion is Frozen, destroy it.
face.flavorText: With her final breath, Sindragosa cursed her consort and all who abandoned her to die in Icecrown. When she was reborn by the hands of the Lich King, her first freezing exhale wrought only pain.

face.name: 厄祖玛特
face.text: 巨型+6 亡语：每有一条厄祖玛特的触须，随机消灭一个敌方随从。
face.flavorText: 亡语：八分遗憾。

face.name: Ozumat
face.text: Colossal +6 Deathrattle: For each of Ozumat's Tentacles, destroy a random enemy minion.
face.flavorText: Deathrattle: You'll be octo-sorry.

face.name: 猎潮者耐普图隆
face.text: 巨型+2 突袭，风怒，每当耐普图隆攻击时，如果你控制着任意耐普图隆之手，改为由手攻击。
face.flavorText: 耐普图隆不愿再把手塞得满满当当。他学会了放手。

face.name: Neptulon the Tidehunter
face.text: Colossal +2, Rush, Windfury Whenever Neptulon attacks, if you control any Hands, they attack instead.
face.flavorText: Neptulon, tired of filling hands, is now throwing hands.

face.name: 可拉克
face.text: 巨型+1 当你控制可拉克的壳时免疫。
face.flavorText: 一万年前，辛艾萨莉落入了海底……有一部分落到了可拉克的壳上。

face.name: Colaque
face.text: Colossal +1 Immune while you control Colaque's Shell.
face.flavorText: Ten thousand years ago, the city of Zin-Azshari fell to the bottom of the sea... and partially onto Colaque's shell.

face.name: 盖亚，巨力机甲
face.text: 巨型+2 在一个友方机械攻击后，对所有敌人造成1点伤害。
face.flavorText: 伊妮总能计划在先。她料到自己会用这项发明来保护她的其他发明。

face.name: Gaia, the Techtonic
face.text: Colossal +2 After a friendly Mech attacks, deal 1 damage to all enemies.
face.flavorText: Always planning ahead, Ini knew she'd need this invention to protect all her other inventions.

face.name: 海兽号
face.text: 巨型+1 突袭，圣盾。在本随从攻击后，探底。
face.flavorText: 由伊妮·积雷亲手建造。这艘巨舰可以陪你闯过几乎任何恶劣环境……但她真心希望你别去那么险恶的地方！

face.name: The Leviathan
face.text: Colossal +1 Rush, Divine Shield After this attacks, Dredge.
face.flavorText: Built by Ini Stormcoil, this massive vessel can withstand almost anything you put it through... although she would prefer you didn't!

face.name: 黑水巨鳗
face.text: 巨型+1 吸血
face.flavorText: 黑水巨鳗最爱的菜品是？炸鱼配上数条……船。

face.name: Blackwater Behemoth
face.text: Colossal +1 Lifesteal
face.flavorText: What's a Blackwater Behemoth's favorite meal? Fish n' Ships.

face.name: 渊狱魔犬希拉格
face.text: 巨型+4 在你的回合开始时，希拉格的蔓足造成的伤害提高1点。
face.flavorText: 上古时代的英雄将魔犬驱赶入海，他们以为那就是结局。然而对希拉格来说，那只是个开始……

face.name: Xhilag of the Abyss
face.text: Colossal +4 At the start of your turn, increase the damage of Xhilag's Stalks by 1.
face.flavorText: When ancient heroes drove a felhunter into the sea, they thought it was the end. But for Xhilag, it was only the beginning...

face.name: 暴食巨鳗格拉格
face.text: 巨型+3 在一个友方随从死亡后，获得其原始属性值。
face.flavorText: 无底海渊食物匮乏，最顶尖的捕食者也不能挑食。哪怕这食物脆硬如铁。

face.name: Glugg the Gulper
face.text: Colossal +3 After a friendly minion dies, gain its original stats.
face.flavorText: Food can be scarce in the Abyssal Depths, leading its top predators to pursue any potential source of sustenance. Even extra crunchy ones.

face.name: 奈利，超巨蛇颈龙
face.text: 巨型+1 战吼：发现三个海盗来构成奈利的船员团队！
face.flavorText: 这头巨兽身披鞍辔，驮载着钩牙船长最爱的船。别把她和她的淡水远亲尼斯搞混了。

face.name: Nellie, the Great Thresher
face.text: Colossal +1 Battlecry: Discover 3 Pirates to crew Nellie's Ship!
face.flavorText: Not to be mistaken for her freshwater cousin, Nessie, this massive creature was harnessed to carry Hooktusk's favorite ship.

face.name: 可拉巴托亚
face.text: 巨型+2 你的可拉巴托亚的钳子拥有+2攻击力。
face.flavorText: 这只巨蟹喜欢弄沉整支舰队，不过饿极了的时候，一艘小艇也能凑合。

face.name: Crabatoa
face.text: Colossal +2 Your Crabatoa Claws have +2 Attack.
face.flavorText: This giant crab loves to sink entire naval fleets, but it'll settle for a single dinghy in a pinch.

face.name: 海卓拉顿
face.text: 巨型+2 战吼：使你的海卓拉顿之头获得突袭。
face.flavorText: 这条多头蛇生长在大海深处，体型极为庞大。这要归功于它稳定的饮食习惯：有什么吃什么。

face.name: Hydralodon
face.text: Colossal +2 Battlecry: Give your Hydralodon Heads Rush.
face.flavorText: Deep beneath the waves, this hydra grew to incredible size based on a steady diet of literally anything that crossed its path.

face.name: 老巨鳍
face.text: 巨型+1 战吼：吞食所有敌方随从。亡语：吐出来。
face.flavorText: 老巨鳍体内的存储空间有多大？大概有一鲸。

face.name: Gigafin
face.text: Colossal +1. Battlecry: Devour all enemy minions. Deathrattle: Spit them back out.
face.flavorText: How much storage does Gigafin's Maw have? About a giga bite.

record.name: 始源领主
record.text: 战吼：&随机获取一张来自过去的巨型随从牌。
record.text_en: Battlecry:& Get a random Colossal minion from the past.
